definitions.gloss: various foreign countries; other countries; foreign nations
definitions.explanation: A collective term referring to multiple foreign countries, often used when comparing Japan with other nations or discussing international trends.

examples.japanese: {諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧みる。
{諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: We should refer to examples from other countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan's education system has unique features compared with those of other countries.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ (various, many) + ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧ (foreign countries). The prefix ⟦{諸|しょ}→諸〜：03956_sho⟧ adds the meaning of "various" or "several," making this a formal way to refer to multiple foreign nations collectively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compare with other countries)
- {諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧ (systems of other countries)
- {諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to lag behind other countries)
- {諸外国|しょがいこく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧ (to learn from other countries)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧ — foreign country; singular or general, less formal
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧ — overseas; broader term that can include regions, not just countries
- ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧ — each country, every country; emphasizes individual countries rather than a collective group

USAGE:
{諸外国|しょがいこく} is a formal expression common in news, policy discussions, and academic writing. It is almost always used from a Japanese perspective, comparing Japan with other nations. It implies a serious, analytical tone.
